recentReviews.author: Maria G.
recentReviews.text: Dr. Lee is amazing! My crown fitting was painless and the staff was so welcoming. Highly recommend!

recentReviews.author: James W.
recentReviews.text: First visit today as a new patient. Very thorough exam, great communication about my treatment options. Front desk was super helpful with insurance questions.

recentReviews.author: Sarah J.
recentReviews.text: Been coming here for years. Dr. Lee is thorough and gentle. Only reason for 4 stars is sometimes the wait runs a bit long.

recentReviews.author: Robert C.
recentReviews.text: Had a root canal done and was nervous but Dr. Lee made it comfortable. The office is clean and modern. Great experience overall.

recentReviews.author: Patricia D.
recentReviews.text: Dr. Lee took the time to explain my denture options clearly. The whole team is kind and professional. So glad I found this practice!
